direction: Shared foundations and current platform roles
strategy: Inspect primary course notes, conversion tutorials, interface standards, original performance model and vendor/runtime documentation; use exact source versions and bounded section coverage.

MCU, SoC and accelerator roles overlap; STM32N6 AI and general-purpose product lines must be distinguished.
Platform roles can be illustrated without unverified performance rankings.
coverage_changes: Foundation evidence and representative platform contracts inspected.

direction: Skeptical audit of abstraction, accuracy, memory, timing and power
strategy: Challenge the provisional teaching claims against the N6 product-line split, MLX synchronization example, CUDA memory paradigms, I2C mode differences, thermal metric caveats, absolute maximum rating notice and OTA partition boundaries. Recompute the synthetic signal and all worked unit conversions.
deliverable: Bounded claims and corrections integrated in the canonical page: N657/N6x7 specificity, Standard/Fast-mode I2C, explicit memory/access limits, ideal energy and kernel-time bounds.
questions_resolved: An N6 series label alone is insufficient to promise Neural-ART.
Shared memory still needs ordering and platform-specific access rules.
Peak arithmetic, weight bytes, average energy and a scheduler each answer only part of a device feasibility question.
Absolute maximum limits and app-update resilience must not be generalized.
coverage_changes: Separate skeptical pass completed; no benchmark or hardware experiment claimed.
next_direction: Verify actual rendered teaching figures, interactive examples and complete exports.
timing_note: Run starts at the prior evidence checkpoint and includes the source-boundary checks and draft audit. It does not claim full-document inspection.

direction: Focused section figures and precision review
strategy: Inspect the article for teaching gaps; add only circuit, board/chip and timing diagrams using the existing data/export contract. Inspect primary latency/throughput teaching material, challenge the dedicated-resource assumptions and calculate the schedule before actual rendered review.
